ctx.x: You'd be surprised how many different organizations you have to belong to to get in this business and be on the ground floor. Do you know that? You've got to belong to AGVA, AFTRA, SAG, NAG and Equity. American Guild of Variety Artists, American Federation for Theater and Radio, Negro Actors Guild, Actors Equity -- all these things you have to belong to in order to get a welfare contingent out of this situation.

Now, I didn't get to tell you about doing a show with Ted Lewis. Did I tell you about the Ted Lewis show? I was his shadow. He used to have a boy called Charlie Witty and Charlie Witty and him got into some kind of difficulty and he thought he'd take me to substitute for Charlie Witty so I went along with him to Frisco for a two-week contract at the Club Bimbo and I worked with him, doing
